-- Old relay triggers can assign an old Business's approval execution to a new
-- Business. Any seed that applied 0040 and re-paired with a pending approval can
-- already contain these rows. Remove only provable cross-Business memberships;
-- retain every audit and do not infer missing historical membership.
-- Count affected memberships before applying:
-- SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_door_relay r JOIN agent_door_audit a ON a.id=r.decision_id
-- WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_door_relay parent
--   WHERE parent.decision_id=json_extract(a.row,'$.decision_id') AND parent.business<>r.business);
DELETE FROM agent_door_relay
WHERE sequence IN (
  SELECT r.sequence FROM agent_door_relay r JOIN agent_door_audit a ON a.id=r.decision_id
  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_door_relay parent
    WHERE parent.decision_id=json_extract(a.row,'$.decision_id') AND parent.business<>r.business)
);

-- Recreate even on databases where the shipped triggers already exist.
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS agent_door_relay_audit_insert;
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS agent_door_relay_audit_update;
-- Executions inherit only their decision's membership, including no membership.
-- Erasure drops the link, door and consent; preserve its existing membership.
-- Plain INSERT then DELETE: an outer UPSERT's conflict policy overrides a trigger's.
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS agent_door_relay_audit_insert AFTER INSERT ON agent_door_audit
WHEN json_extract(NEW.row,'$.door')='mcp' AND json_extract(NEW.row,'$.consent') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO agent_door_relay(decision_id,business)
    SELECT NEW.id,business FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN json_extract(NEW.row,'$.decision_id') IS NOT NULL THEN
      (SELECT business FROM agent_door_relay WHERE decision_id=json_extract(NEW.row,'$.decision_id') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1)
    ELSE COALESCE((SELECT business FROM agent_door_relay WHERE decision_id=NEW.id ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT json_extract(envelope,'$.business') FROM agent_door_state WHERE id=1)) END AS business)
    WHERE business IS NOT NULL;
  DELETE FROM agent_door_relay WHERE decision_id=NEW.id AND (
    sequence<(SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM agent_door_relay WHERE decision_id=NEW.id)
    OR (json_extract(NEW.row,'$.decision_id') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM agent_door_relay WHERE decision_id=json_extract(NEW.row,'$.decision_id'))));
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS agent_door_relay_audit_update AFTER UPDATE ON agent_door_audit
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_door_relay WHERE decision_id=NEW.id)
  OR (json_extract(NEW.row,'$.door')='mcp' AND json_extract(NEW.row,'$.consent') IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO agent_door_relay(decision_id,business)
    SELECT NEW.id,business FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN json_extract(NEW.row,'$.decision_id') IS NOT NULL THEN
      (SELECT business FROM agent_door_relay WHERE decision_id=json_extract(NEW.row,'$.decision_id') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1)
    ELSE COALESCE((SELECT business FROM agent_door_relay WHERE decision_id=NEW.id ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT json_extract(envelope,'$.business') FROM agent_door_state WHERE id=1)) END AS business)
    WHERE business IS NOT NULL;
  DELETE FROM agent_door_relay WHERE decision_id=NEW.id AND (
    sequence<(SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM agent_door_relay WHERE decision_id=NEW.id)
    OR (json_extract(NEW.row,'$.decision_id') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(

-- legacy_import_runs says when. A source row that became several rows names them in lists (conversations,conversation_ai), and
-- the first is the entity. Only a FULL import counts (a run with no delta or since marker: a delta batch already
-- removed its own trigger rows), and only once every run of its package is complete. A package's window is its first run
-- start to its last run completion. A row goes only when it names an imported entity AND carries a time inside that window:
-- a contact event is stamped with the wall clock of the write, so it must fall between first start and last completion, and

CREATE TABLE legacy_repair_scope(kind TEXT NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,first_at INTEGER NOT NULL,last_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(kind,id)) WITHOUT ROWID;
INSERT INTO legacy_repair_scope(kind,id,first_at,last_at)
 SELECT substr(j.target_table,1,instr(j.target_table||',',',')-1) kind,substr(j.target_key,1,instr(j.target_key||',',',')-1) id,min(p.first_at),max(p.last_at)
 FROM legacy_import_rows j
 JOIN legacy_import_runs r ON r.id=j.run_id AND json_extract(r.source_json,'$.delta') IS NULL AND json_extract(r.source_json,'$.since') IS NULL
 JOIN (SELECT coalesce(json_extract(source_json,'$.package'),CASE WHEN id LIKE 'legacy-package:%' THEN substr(id,16) ELSE id END) package,min(created_at) first_at,max(completed_at) last_at
       FROM legacy_import_runs WHERE json_extract(source_json,'$.delta') IS NULL AND json_extract(source_json,'$.since') IS NULL
       GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)=count(completed_at) AND min(state='complete')=1) p
   ON p.package=coalesce(json_extract(r.source_json,'$.package'),CASE WHEN r.id LIKE 'legacy-package:%' THEN substr(r.id,16) ELSE r.id END)
 WHERE j.source_table IN ('contacts','conversations','articles','knowledge_articles') AND j.status='mapped' AND substr(j.target_table,1,instr(j.target_table||',',',')-1) IN ('contacts','conversations','knowledge_articles')
 GROUP BY 1,2;

migrations.name: 321_legacy_import_files.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Imported legacy files that have no conversation: a workspace's logo and widget background, its team's and assistants'
-- avatars and its article images (src/modules/legacy-import/media-index.ts). A legacy import that rewrites a legacy
-- storage URL naming such a file writes one row here, keyed by the workspace and the legacy media id, and the URL
-- becomes /api/imported-files/<workspace>/<media id> (file-door.ts). audience 'public' (a file legacy linked to the
-- workspace, a teammate or an assistant) is served to anyone, so the widget shows it on the customer's own site;
-- 'article' (a file legacy linked to an article) is served to the workspace's members and to whoever may read an
-- article that holds its URL. A conversation's files keep their native media rows and route; no row here names one.
-- Additive only: the table starts empty and existing rows are untouched. A workspace imported earlier gets its rows
-- from scripts/legacy-import/upgrade.mjs.
CREATE TABLE legacy_import_files(project_id TEXT NOT NULL,media_id TEXT NOT NULL,object_key TEXT NOT NULL,content_type TEXT NOT NULL,filename TEXT NOT NULL,audience TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(audience IN ('public','article')),PRIMARY KEY(project_id,media_id)) WITHOUT ROWID;

migrations.name: 322_contact_address_lookup.sql
migrations.sql:
-- An inbound mail looks its sender's and each Cc's contact up by address with the expressions lower(email) and
-- lower(json_extract(metadata_json,'$.provided_email')) (src/modules/integrations/inbound-service.ts and
-- inbound-authority.ts: the blocked-sender check, the sender's contact and its insert guard, a reply's sender through a
-- reply address or from a preferred notification address). No index held either expression (api_contact_key_0 and _1
-- in 253 hold lower(trim(...)), which these lookups cannot use), so each lookup walked every contact of the workspace:
-- about 162,000 rows on a large imported workspace. These two indexes hold the lookups' expressions verbatim, so each
-- lookup searches its address and reads only the contacts holding it; the lookups' text and matches are unchanged.
-- Additive: no row changes.
CREATE INDEX contacts_address_lookup ON contacts(project_id,lower(email));
CREATE INDEX contacts_preferred_address_lookup ON contacts(project_id,lower(json_extract(metadata_json,'$.provided_email')));

migrations.name: 324_knowledge_documents_version_url.sql
migrations.sql:
-- The knowledge reference policy (src/modules/knowledge/reference-policy.ts, documentCurrent) decides whether a cited
-- crawled page is still current. A page of the published version is current; a page of an older crawl version is
-- current only if the published version holds a page at the same URL. That second lookup is
-- `SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_documents WHERE version_id=<published version> AND url=<the older page's url>`, and the only
-- index on knowledge_documents holding version_id was knowledge_documents_version(version_id), so it walked every
-- page of the published version for each cited source whose URL is no longer published: 644 rows per source, about
-- 2.6 million rows to evaluate 16 copied passages of 255 older-version sources on a large imported workspace.
-- This index holds both columns, so the lookup searches (version_id,url) and reads only the pages at that URL.
-- Additive: no row, column or statement changes; the lookup's matches are unchanged.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_documents_version_url ON knowledge_documents(version_id,url);
